questions.question: In each of the following questions, a specific relationship is given between two words. Identify the word that shares a similar semantic relationship with the given pair. Choose the most appropriate option from the four choices given below. Knife : Cut :: Pen : ?
questions.questionHtml:
In each of the following questions, a specific relationship is given between two words. Identify the word that shares a similar semantic relationship with the given pair. Choose the most appropriate option from the four choices given below.

Knife : Cut :: Pen : ?
questions.solution:
Knife : Cut → A knife is used to cut. So, Pen : ? → A pen is used to write .

Correct relationship: Pen : Write

Answer: Write

questions.question: If Neha is facing south and turns 90° to her left, then 180° to her right, and finally 90° to her left again, which direction is she facing now?
questions.questionHtml: If Neha is facing south and turns 90° to her left, then 180° to her right, and finally 90° to her left again, which direction is she facing now?
questions.solution:
Initial direction: Neha is facing South .

First turn – 90° to her left: From South, turning 90° left → she now faces East .

Second turn – 180° to her right: From East, turning 180° right → she now faces West .

Third turn – 90° to her left: From West, turning 90° left → she now faces South .

Correct answer: South

questions.question: Ravi walked 8 meters north, turned right and walked 6 meters, turned right again and walked 8 meters. In which direction is he now facing?
questions.questionHtml: Ravi walked 8 meters north, turned right and walked 6 meters, turned right again and walked 8 meters. In which direction is he now facing?
questions.solution:
Ravi walks 8 meters north → facing North

Turns right → now facing East , walks 6 meters

Turns right again → now facing South , walks 8 meters

Final direction: South

questions.question: Ravi walks 20 m N, right 30 m, again right 20 m. Which direction now?
questions.questionHtml: Ravi walks 20 m N, right 30 m, again right 20 m. Which direction now?
questions.solution:
Let’s trace Ravi’s movement step by step:

Walks 20 m North → facing North

Turns right → now facing East , walks 30 m

Turns right again → now facing South , walks 20 m

✅ Final direction: South

Correct answer: South

questions.question: Kiran walks 7 km south, then turns to her right and walks 4 km. She again turns to her right and walks 7 km. How far is she from her starting point?
questions.questionHtml: Kiran walks 7 km south, then turns to her right and walks 4 km. She again turns to her right and walks 7 km. How far is she from her starting point?
questions.solution:
Explanation :

She walks 7 km south

Turns right → now facing west , walks 4 km

Turns right again → now facing north , walks 7 km

Now she’s back at the same north-south level as her starting point, but 4 km west of it.

👉 So, the shortest distance from her starting point is 4 km

✅ Correct answer: 4 km

questions.question: A man walks 4 km north, then turns right and walks 3 km. Then turns right again and walks 4 km. What is the shortest distance from his starting point?
questions.questionHtml:
A man walks 4 km north, then turns right and walks 3 km. Then turns right again and walks 4 km.
What is the shortest distance from his starting point?
questions.solution:
Explanation :

Starts facing North , walks 4 km → now 4 km north of starting point

Turns right → now facing East , walks 3 km → now 3 km east of that point

Turns right again → now facing South , walks 4 km → now back at the same horizontal level as starting point, but 3 km to the East

So, his final position is 3 km East of the starting point.

👉 Shortest distance from starting point = 3 km

✅ Correct answer: 3 km

questions.question: Rohan walks 10 meters towards the North. Then he turns right and walks 5 meters. Again, he turns right and walks 10 meters. In which direction is he now from his starting point?
questions.questionHtml:
Rohan walks 10 meters towards the North. Then he turns right and walks 5 meters. Again, he turns right and walks 10 meters.
In which direction is he now from his starting point?
questions.solution:
Starts facing North , walks 10 meters → now 10 meters north of starting point

Turns right → now facing East , walks 5 meters → now 5 meters east of that point

Turns right again → now facing South , walks 10 meters → now back at the same horizontal level as starting point, but 5 meters to the East

So, Rohan is now 5 meters East of his starting point.

Correct answer: East

questions.question: If North becomes South-West, what will West become?
questions.questionHtml: If North becomes South-West, what will West become?
questions.solution:
If North = South-West , then all directions are rotated 135° anticlockwise .

• North → South-West

• East → South-East

• South → North-East

• West → South-East

Hence, West becomes South-East .

questions.question: If South-East becomes North, then what will North-East become?
questions.questionHtml: If South-East becomes North, then what will North-East become?
questions.solution:
– Treat it as a rotation of directions so that South-East moves to the top (North) .
– On a compass: NE is at 45°, SE at 135°. To make SE → North, rotate everything 135° anticlockwise .
– Apply the same rotation to NE: 45° − 135° = −90° ≡ 270° , which corresponds to West .
– Hence North-East becomes West → Option 2 .

questions.question: A man walks 12 km north, then turns right and walks 8 km, then again turns right and walks 12 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.questionHtml: A man walks 12 km north, then turns right and walks 8 km, then again turns right and walks 12 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.solution: Path followed: 1. First 12 km north. 2. Then 8 km east (right turn). 3. Then 12 km south (right turn). Now he is at the same east-west level as the starting point but 8 km east. So, the distance from the starting point is 8 km .
